name: app-warm-beige-smart-home-security-rooms-and-statistics-screens-sheet
title: Beige Smart-Home Security, Rooms and Statistics Sheet
whatItIs: A tall warm beige sheet in a rounded frame with header labels and three sections, Security (locked door and lock settings), Rooms (kitchen and active devices) and Statistics (energy use), each with phones and a short caption at the side, divided by hairlines.
whatItMeans: Photographic headers and warm neutral UI make a technical topic homely, and repeated section structure keeps it tidy.
techniques: Phone pairs with captions alternating sides
Photographic headers inside screens fading to cream
Lime highlight on the unlock control
Orange line chart as a single accent

vocabulary.definition: A hairline separating sections of a page.
A photograph at the top of a screen fading into the UI.
A slider that completes an action when dragged.
